entries.title: Chat & Friends Stability Update
items: Added shared message deletion with a visible Message deleted state.
Added Shift + left-click deletion for your own messages.
Unified sticker reactions with emoji reactions.
Improved sticker sizing, bookmarks, avatars, and reaction controls.
Fixed Friends chat layout and viewport sizing.
Improved picker and navigation behavior across Global Chat and Friends.

entries.title: Emoji & Sticker Collection
items: Added full emoji browsing with search and recently used emojis.
Added sticker creation and upload directly into your collection.
Added sticker reaction support for Global Chat and Friends.

entries.title: Lunar Glass UI
items: Expanded the glass interface styling across chat surfaces.
Improved theme customization and cursor persistence.
Added richer picker, reaction, and profile surfaces.
